input: Find horseback riding and equestrian summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Ruby Ranch
candidates.note: Summer ranch camps combine horseback riding, art, music and creek exploration.

candidates.name: Full Moon Equestrian
candidates.note: Ages 6+; 2025 day camp included riding, horse care, groundwork and crafts.

candidates.name: Winding Creek Stables
candidates.note: 2025 summer camps; equestrian adventure camp requires posting-trot proficiency; moved from Asheville to Rutherfordton.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Day and overnight summer programs include equestrian camp with arena activities and trail rides.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong horseback skills camps plus English riding and horse care during regular overnight sessions.

candidates.name: Foothills Equestrian Nature Center (FENCE)
candidates.note: 2026 horse camps for ages 5–12, plus full-day, half-day and nature/art summer camps.

candidates.name: Miller Eventing
candidates.note: July 2026 summer camp at FENCE for young riders developing eventing skills.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp for Girls
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–16; regular riding activities and a separate weeklong equestrian camp for ages 11–16.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with riding and horsemanship; summer 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Coed residential summer camp with horseback riding, farm activities, outdoor recreation and crafts.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with English riding, horse care and trail rides; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp; 2026 riding program offered hunt-seat lessons for beginner through advanced riders.

candidates.name: Camps Kahdalea and Chosatonga
candidates.note: Separate girls’ and boys’ overnight camps, generally ages 8–17, sharing riding facilities and English instruction.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–17; overnight camp with English riding and horse trips; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Boys ages 6–17; summer camp with riding instruction, horse care and wilderness trips.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with Western riding and horse care at Thunderhead Ranch; 2027 dates posted.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
candidates.note: Girls’ residential summer camp offering horseback riding among more than 40 activities.

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer
candidates.note: Coed summer camp, ages 5–16, with optional English riding instruction for beginning and advanced riders.

candidates.name: Eagle’s Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Coed Eagle’s Nest Camp offers horseback riding among elective activities; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls offer horseback riding; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camps Merri-Mac and Timberlake
candidates.note: Merri-Mac girls’ camp offered riding and trail rides in 2026; sister boys’ camp Timberlake has a separate campus.
